requirements.title: Reading & Composition A
requirements.notes: First half of R&C (an R1A or R4A course), or an AP/IB exam score. Complete by the end of your first year.

requirements.title: Reading & Composition B
requirements.notes: Second half of R&C (an R1B or R4B course). Complete by the end of your second year.

requirements.title: Humanities & Social Sciences (H/SS)
requirements.notes: Six H/SS courses in total, of 3+ units each: the two R&C courses plus four more, at least two of which are upper division (and in practice two in the same discipline). An AC course may count. Courses must be taken for a letter grade except where noted.

requirements.title: Engineering unit minimum

rule.text: Complete at least 45 units of engineering coursework (varies by major)

requirements.notes: Check your major's handbook; most CoE majors exceed this through major requirements.

requirements.title: Senior residence

rule.text: Senior residence: after reaching 90 units, complete at least 24 of your remaining units over two semesters in residence in your college

requirements.notes: Exceptions for UCEAP, UCDC, and other approved programs.
